evidence.commitSubject: test: add re-submit reset coverage for duplicate-email error in TrialSignupForm
evidence.commitBody: Adds a test verifying that isDuplicateEmailError resets on the next submit, so the sign-in link clears when the user retries with a different email. Covers the reset path (setIsDuplicateEmailError(false) at handleSubmit start) that the existing 4 tests did not exercise.

supersedingCommitOnMain.subject: test: strengthen duplicate-email sign-in link tests for TrialSignupForm
supersedingCommitOnMain.note: This commit (5 days before the orphan commit) already created the same file with MORE comprehensive coverage — 117 lines including detection logic for 409 status, 'already exists' message, sign-in link rendering in both compact/full variants, and e2e code-inspection tests. The orphan's 43-line reset test is a strict subset of what main already provides.

riskRationale: The test file already exists on main with a superset of the orphan's coverage. No unique logic is lost by deleting the orphan branch. No open PR was ever created. The orphan's only commit is a net subset of what main already contains.
recommendationDetail: Delete remote branch dev/f167334d-fix-duplicate-email-signin-link. The single commit adds a test for isDuplicateEmailError reset-on-resubmit, but main's 88f0b9af (2026-05-16) already includes that same file with broader coverage. The orphan was created after the superseding commit landed and was never turned into a PR.
